sentences.text: Ranjan Paul & Ors vs Unknown on 14 August, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
14.08.2024
 Sl No.37
Court No.29
 (gc)
 (Rejected)
 Crm (A) 2771 of 2024
 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438 of
 the Code of Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of
 the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in
 connection with Naihati Police Station Case No.59 of 2024 dated
 24.02.2024 under Sections 498A/326/307/506/34 of the Indian
 Penal Code and adding Section 302 of the Ipc.
 And
 In the matter of : Ranjan Paul & Ors.
 - Petitioners.
 Md. Kutubuddin
 ....For the Petitioners.
 Mr. Joydeep Roy, Ld. Jr. Govt. Adv.,
 Mr. Soumya Basu Roy Chowdhury
 ... For the State.

1.
The petitioners pray for anticipatory bail.
2. The learned Counsel for the State has relied upon the statements of the victim who alleged to have suffered burn injury while she was undergoing treatment at the Government Hospital.

3. In view of the statements of the victim appearing from the case diary which are in the nature of dying declaration implicating the petitioners and the initial forensic examination suggests murder,
we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
4. Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail is rejected.
5. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.)
